% 01.12.2025 CRL.M.(BAIL) 2086/2025 (suspension of sentence)
1. The present application has been filed seeking suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal.

2. By way of the appeal, the appellant seeks to assail the judgment of conviction dated 30.08.2019 and the order on sentence dated 07.09.2019, vide which he and his co-convict/Ashutosh @ Sonu were directed to undergo RI for a period of 20 years along with payment of fine of Rs.30,000/- each,
in default whereof they would undergo SI for 1 year each, for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(g) IPC.

They were further sentenced to undergo SI for a period of 1 year each for the offence punishable under Sections 342/34 IPC and SI for a period of 2 years each for the offence This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 05/12/2025 at 21:05:35 punishable under Section 596 IPC.
All sentences of the co-convicts respectively were directed to run concurrently and the benefit under Section 428 Cr.P.C. was also provided.

4. The appellant's application seeking suspension of sentence was allowed to be withdrawn on 21.08.2025 after arguments.
5. The only ground taken in the present application is the suspension of sentence of the co-convict/Ashutosh @ Sonu.

A reading of the order passed reveals that his sentence was suspended considering that he had undergone nearly half of the sentence, as well as keeping in view the peculiar medical facts of his family.
6. As per the nominal roll of the present appellant, he has undergone only about 7 years and 4 months out of his total sentence of 20 years.
7. In view of the aforesaid, no ground to entertain the present application is made out and the same is accordingly dismissed.
List in due course.
